items.expected: The validated isolated-molecule calculations support the qualitative author hypothesis that phosphonium-centered noncovalent interactions can activate PO and interact with a propagating chain-end model, with the PA zwitterion showing the relevant electrostatic/charge redistribution; the evidence is mechanistic support rather than a complete catalytic proof.
